# The timeline agreement corpus: every series on which ical-rs and both
# oracles, recurring-ical-events 3.9.0 and ical.js 2.2.1 (zones of
# @nextcloud/timezones 1.0.2, tzdata 2025b), answer alike, over the calendars
# of tests/corpus/rie (named bare), tests/corpus/icaljs and tests/corpus/libical
# (named by their folder) and the windows of windows.tsv. Three tab-separated
# fields: the calendar, the UID (`-` for every component with none), and the
# earliest 200 occurrences starting in the window, comma separated, each
# `start/end`. A start is UTC (Z), floating, or a date. Generated by
# harness/run.sh.
